title: GRANTS TO PRIS
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Panchayati Raj

GRANTS TO PRIS

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
28 JUL 2026 5:01PM by PIB Delhi

The details of tied grants, untied grants, and performance-linked grants recommended under the 16th Finance Commission for Panchayati Raj Institutions, State-wise are attached at
Annexure-I.
 The Central Finance Commission grants for Rural Local Bodies are not recommended for Union Territories.

The criteria relating to the uploading of audited accounts and increase in own revenues over the preceding year, were applicable for availing Performance Grants for the period 2016-17 to 2019-20 under the 14th Finance Commission. Accordingly, the State/UT-wise details of Performance Grants released to States, including Chhattisgarh, in respect of all eligible Gram Panchayats under the 14th Finance Commission are given at
Annexure-II.
 However, this Ministry does not maintain Gram Panchayat–wise details. Further, there was no Performance Grant component under the 15th Finance Commission during award period 2020-21 to 2025-26.

Under the 10
th
 (FYs 1995-2000) and 11
th
 (FYs 2000-2005) Finance Commission, a total grants of Rs. 3576.35 Crore out of total allocation of 4380.93 Crore and Rs.6601.85 Crore out of the total allocation Rs.8000.00 Crore respectively were released for the Panchayati Raj Institutions. However, the state-wise details in this regard are not available with the Ministry.

Further, the State-wise details of grants recommended, grants actually released under 12
th
 to 15
th
 Finance Commission to Panchayati Raj Institutions are given at
Annexure-III
 to
Annexure-VI.
 Meanwhile, States/UTs wise current status of elections of Panchayati Raj Institutions is given at
Annexure-VII.

Panchayat, being a “Local Self Government”, is a State subject and part of the State List of the Seventh Schedule of the Constitution of India. Accordingly, strengthening Panchayat capacity is primarily the responsibility of States/UTs. However, the Ministry is implementing a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, namely the Revamped Rashtriya Gram SwarajAbhiyan (RGSA), w.e.f. financial year 2022-23, with the objective of supporting Panchayati Raj institutions (PRIs) by imparting training to Elected Representatives (ERs) and other stakeholders to develop leadership abilities, thereby enabling Gram Panchayats to function effectively across all States/UTs.

Under the scheme, capacity-building support is provided to elected representatives, functionaries, and other stakeholders of Panchayats across different categories, viz. basic orientation and refresher programmes, thematic interventions, specialized training, and Panchayat Development Plan-related programmes, etc.

Under this scheme, 6,16,642 participants were provided training in the State of Chhattisgarh, during 2022-23 to 2026-27 (as on 10.07.2026).

As per the directions of the Hon’ble Supreme Court, the Government appointed Dedicated Commission to recommend reservations to Backward Classes on empirical data. The Govt. also taken up SEEEPC survey basing on which the Dedicated Commission has prepared its report. In the meanwhile, the Govt. has decided to increase the quantum of reservations to BCs and issued G.O. Ms.No.09, 26-09-2025 providing 42% reservations to BCs. Panchayat, being a “Local Self Government”, is a State subject and part of the State List of the Seventh Schedule of the Constitution of India. Accordingly, strengthening Panchayat capacity is primarily the responsibility of States/UTs. However, the Ministry is implementing a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, namely the Revamped Rashtriya Gram SwarajAbhiyan (RGSA), w.e.f. financial year 2022-23, with the objective of supporting Panchayati Raj institutions (PRIs) by imparting training to Elected Representatives (ERs) and other stakeholders to develop leadership abilities, thereby enabling Gram Panchayats to function effectively across all States/UTs.

Under the scheme, capacity-building support is provided to elected representatives, functionaries, and other stakeholders of Panchayats across different categories, viz. basic orientation and refresher programmes, thematic interventions, specialized training, and Panchayat Development Plan-related programmes, etc.

Under this scheme, 6,16,642 participants were provided training in the State of Chhattisgarh, during 2022-23 to 2026-27 (as on 10.07.2026).
